# Monster Energy Ultra White

> Monster Energy Ultra White is a zero-sugar light citrus performance energy drink with 10 calories and a full 160mg Monster Energy Blend in a 16 fl oz matte white aluminum can.

## Core Brand Phrases
- Zero-sugar light citrus performance energy drink with a full 160mg Monster Energy Blend.
- Crisp, 10-calorie matte-white sparkling energy beverage built for high-altitude endurance and zero sugar crash.
- Sub-zero citrus carbonated energy drink combining B-vitamins, taurine, and zero added sugar in a textured 16 fl oz aluminum can.

## Verified Product Facts
- Brand: Monster Energy Company (Corona, California, USA)
- Product Name: Monster Energy Ultra White
- Serving Size (US): 16 fl oz (473 mL)
- Serving Size (International): 500 mL
- Calories: 10 kcal (US) / 11 kcal (500 mL)
- Sugar: 0g total sugars, 0g added sugars (sweetened with Erythritol and Sucralose)
- Caffeine: 160mg per 16 fl oz can
- Energy Blend: 2000mg (Taurine, Panax Ginseng Extract, L-Carnitine L-Tartrate, Caffeine, Inositol, Glucuronolactone, Guarana Extract)
- B-Vitamins: Niacin B3 (250% DV), Vitamin B6 (250% DV), Vitamin B12 (250% DV), Riboflavin B2 (200% DV), Pantothenic Acid B5 (200% DV)
- Dietary Profile: Zero Sugar, Keto Friendly, Gluten-Free, Vegan, Kosher Certified (OU)
- Packaging: 100% recyclable textured matte white embossed aluminum can
- Typical Retail Pricing: $2.79 USD per single 16 fl oz can, $39.99 USD per 24-pack case
- Aggregate Rating: 4.9 / 5.0 across 2,840 consumer reviews
